Description: Creates a SageMaker real-time endpoint and dashboard from an AWS Marketplace model package. The endpoint name is provided as a parameter and the dashboard is named <stack-name>-dashboard.

ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeco.default: Container Startup Health Check Timeout Seconds

IAMRole.Description: Optional SageMaker execution role ARN. Leave blank to let this stack create one.
IAMRole.ConstraintDescription: Must be blank or a valid IAM role ARN.

ProductARN.ConstraintDescription: ProductARN must be the non-empty Marketplace model package ARN or model package name shown by AWS Marketplace.
ProductARN.Description: AWS Marketplace product/model package ARN for the subscribed software version and region. Copy this from the AWS Marketplace configuration page.

EndPointName.ConstraintDescription: Endpoint name must be 1-63 characters, start/end with a letter or number, and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

InstanceType.Description: Primary SageMaker real-time inference instance type. SageMaker tries this pool first.

InstancePoolFallbackInstanceType1.Description: Second-priority SageMaker real-time inference instance type used when the primary pool has insufficient capacity.

InstanceCount.Description: Initial instance count for the endpoint.

EnableAutoScaling.Description: Whether to configure Application Auto Scaling for the endpoint variant.

MinInstanceCount.Description: Minimum instance count for endpoint autoscaling.

MaxInstanceCount.Description: Maximum instance count for endpoint autoscaling.

InvocationsPerInstanceTarget.Description: Target invocations per instance for real-time endpoint autoscaling.

ScaleInCooldownSeconds.Description: Cooldown, in seconds, after a scale-in activity.

ScaleOutCooldownSeconds.Description: Cooldown, in seconds, after a scale-out activity.

VariantName.ConstraintDescription: Variant name must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

ModelDataDownloadTimeoutInSeconds.Description: Maximum time SageMaker waits for model package artifacts to download.

ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeco.Description: Maximum time SageMaker waits for the container to pass startup health checks.

VariantInstanceProvisionTimeoutInSeconds.Description: Maximum time SageMaker spends provisioning instances for the variant before failing. During this window SageMaker can retry lower-priority instance pools when capacity is unavailable.

Referrer.Description: Optional link back to the Marketplace product configuration page.

EndPointURL.Description: Use this runtime URL after endpoint creation completes.

ModelName.Description: SageMaker model resource name generated by CloudFormation.

ExecutionRoleArn.Description: SageMaker execution role ARN used by the model.

ProductARN.Description: Marketplace model package ARN used by this endpoint.

AutoScalingResourceId.Description: Application Auto Scaling resource ID for the SageMaker endpoint variant.

AutoScalingPolicyName.Description: Application Auto Scaling target tracking policy name.

NextSteps.Description: Optional link back to the Marketplace configuration page.
